designPrinciples.principle: Long unbroken sightlines (>35m) must feature staggered waist-high defilade at 12-14m intervals to protect advancing CQB players from sniper spawn-camping.
Every competitive map must maintain at least 3 distinct vertical tiers with a delta of >= 8.0m, and all sniper nests must have at least 2 independent ascent paths.
Ground slabs must not be sterile; they must feature procedural drafting margin lines, coffee cup ring stains, and authentic ballpoint biro hatching.
Maps must not be static monolithic boxes; they must incorporate at least 2 active kinetic ambient actors (rotating brass gears, swinging pendulums, cascading ink ribbons).
Grapple rings must be chained every 8-12m with >= 1.5m clearance to allow high-velocity aerial traversal across central chasms.
No map may be certified that possesses lower architectural, visual, or kinetic complexity than The Colossal Canopy and Giant Classroom.

retrospectives.verdict: Gold standard for organic multi-tier canopy verticality and hollow log tunnels.
Flawless industrial kinetic steampunk archetype with active boiler works and valve banks.
Vibrant arcade midway with high-density pinball bumpers and skee-ball corridors.
Subterranean anomalous biome with resonant crystal spires and basalt terracing.
